source: segmentation (internet footage, background replaced by white)
time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0; frame for time t = round(t * fps)
units: pixels and seconds; x to the right, y downward; no metric scale
duplicate_frames_note: every 5th frame repeats the previous one (25->30 fps conversion), so the frame-to-frame motion is 0 there and roughly 1.2x normal on the neighbouring steps

toy_truck.description: toy dump truck: blue cab (front, facing left) with a yellow toy driver, red dump bed, yellow chassis, 4 black wheels (2 visible). The only object that really moves
toy_truck.direction: rolls right-to-left (-x), from the man toward the seated child
toy_truck.reference_point: visible centre. Use bbox_cx/cy for frames 6-35. In frames 0-3 the rear is covered by the man's knee, so use cx_from_front = front bumper x + (207-1)/2 there
toy_truck.y_motion: about 4-6 px drift in y over the clip (essentially horizontal motion)

man.description: adult man crouching at the right: black T-shirt, blue jeans, dark shoes. He pushes the truck (his hand rests on the rear top of the dump bed in frames 0-5). Otherwise he barely moves; his image drift comes from the camera
man.moves: only small arm and hand movement; image drift is mostly camera pan/zoom

child.description: toddler sitting on the floor at the left, facing right, legs stretched toward the truck: dark navy T-shirt and shorts, black socks/shoes
child.moves: small movement of the legs/feet; image drift is mostly camera

static_objects: none visible: the background, floor and any markings were replaced by white in the segmented video

events.event: video starts with the truck already moving left (about 13 px/frame from frame 0 to 1); the man's hand is on the bed and his knee covers the truck's rear
the truck's rear clears the man's knee; full truck visible from here
release: the man's fingertips have lost contact with the dump bed (contact last seen at frame 5, gap visible at frame 6). Uncertainty +-1 frame
the truck front bumper is within 2 px (in x) of the child's right foot
the x-ranges of the truck front and the child's foot overlap: the truck reaches the child's feet (possible contact at frames 33-35). The truck is still moving about 5 px/frame at the end
end of video; the truck is still rolling, no stop observed

camera.type: hand-held, pans to follow the truck plus a slight zoom-in
camera.model: frame-0 coordinates -> frame i: x_i = scale*x_0 + tx, y_i = scale*y_0 + ty; inverse x_0 = (x_i - tx)/scale
camera.note: With no background, this is estimated from patches on the child and man, assuming they stay still (fit rms about 1-2 px). The image content shifts by about +40 to +57 px in x over the clip (the camera turns left, following the truck), and the scale grows by about 1.8%

perspective: side view, approximately planar motion parallel to the image; the truck's apparent size stays constant (length 205-210 px)
